record.body:
## Problem

The session that builds also grades. Acceptances can pass while the work-item description is unmet (dogfood: `status-tabs`). There is no independent, read-only review of the phase diff against task specs before merge.

## Approach

Decisions: phase-reviewer-scope (phase-end core; defer per-task and pre-dispatch coverage), reviewer-inputs (specs + acceptances + invariants + phase diff only). Structured work: specification and design `phase-reviewer`.

Ship `agents/se-reviewer.md` (sync via `sync-plugin.sh`); build a restricted brief; have execute-phase invoke the reviewer after the closing verification task and before merge; parent records `method: review` check-run, findings, and the integration-report from reviewer output; fixable NEEDS_WORK becomes retry-loop fix tasks with one re-run; phase gate requires a passing review at head. Out of scope: per-task review, plan-time coverage check, tier-2 suite.

**Size:** more than one
**Human stops:** plan review; Landing merge into `main` (no push)
**Collision notes:** wave 1 splits `agents/`+`sync-plugin.sh` from `se_workflow/` brief helper; wave 2 — only `reviewer-execute` edits `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md`; `status-tabs-fixture` adds tests/fixtures only. Do not parallelize two editors on `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md`.

## Exit criteria

- Reviewer agent exists with restricted tools; execute-phase invokes it at phase end with input limits proven by test.
- Parent records review check-run + findings; reviewer writes nothing.
- Fixable NEEDS_WORK creates fix tasks under retry budget; one re-run; budget exhaustion escalates.
- Phase gate requires passing review at head before merge.
- `status-tabs` fixture returns NEEDS_WORK / spec-gap.
- Integration report comes from reviewer output; skill↔contract consistency stays green.

## Landing

- **branch:** `phase/phase-reviewer`
- **worktree:** `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--phase-reviewer`
- **base:** `main`
- **close:** commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into `main`; commit the store on the primary checkout
- **push:** not a stop (do not push)
